newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory cocoa product exports rise in September.
newsitem.headline: Ivory cocoa product exports rise in September.

text.p: Ivory Coast exported 8,808 tonnes of semi-finished cocoa products in September 1996 against 5,792 in August, official data show.
Exports in September 1995 amounted to 5,434 tonnes.
Cumulative exports near the close of the extended 1995/96 (Oct-Sept) season were 65,663 tonnes against 51,290 tonnes in the same period of the 1994/95 season.
The September data did not separate liquor, butter and cake exports but they showed additional shipments of 524 tonnes of powder.
Cumulative powder shipments stood at 5,039 tonnes, against 449 tonnes previously, reflecting Ivory Coast's policy of promoting local processing of cocoa beans.
Ivory Coast's 1996/97 season opened late on October 24, leaving exporters wondering which marketing year would apply for October 1-24 export volumes.
New marketing seasons usually open in early October.
